title: Mount an NFS share
description: Mount a directory exported by an NFS server on a local mount point.

parameters.name: server
parameters.label: Server
parameters.description: Name or address of the file server

parameters.name: mountPoint
parameters.label: Mount point
parameters.description: Existing local directory to mount on

examples.description: Mount the data export of nas01
Mount the share at every boot

notes: Requires sudo and nfs-utils (RHEL) or nfs-common (Debian). The mount point must exist.
